question: Dubnium, an artificially produced radioactive transuranium element with atomic number 105, is present in which group of the periodic table?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Group 5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dubnium** is an artificially produced radioactive **transuranium element** with an atomic number of **105**.
 
• It is classified as a member of **Group 5** in the periodic table.
 
• Group 5 elements are characterized by their **valence electron configuration**, which is typically **d¹s²**, meaning they have one electron in their **d-orbital**.
 
• Other elements in Group 5 include **vanadium (V)**, **niobium (Nb)**, and **tantalum (Ta)**, which share similar chemical properties.
 
• **Dubnium** is named after the Russian town of **Dubna**, where it was first synthesized at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research.
 
• Like other transuranium elements, **Dubnium** is highly unstable and exists only in minute quantities in laboratory settings.
 
• Its most stable isotope is **Dubnium-268**, which has a half-life of approximately **16 hours**.
 
• Elements in Group 5 exhibit **high melting points**, **metallic bonding**, and strong **oxidizing properties**.
 
• They are often used in studies involving **nuclear chemistry** and high-energy physics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Group 3**__

 __
 
• Group 3 includes elements like **scandium (Sc)**, **yttrium (Y)**, and the **lanthanides**.
 
• These elements are known for their **rare earth properties** and are widely used in **electronics** and **magnets**.
 
• They exhibit a valence electron configuration of **d¹s²**, similar to Group 5, but their chemical behavior differs significantly.
 
 
 
• **Group 7**__
 __
 
• Group 7 elements include **manganese (Mn)**, **technetium (Tc)**, and **rhenium (Re)**.
 
• These elements are characterized by their **multiple oxidation states** and are used in **catalysts**, **medical imaging**, and **alloys**.
 
• Technetium, like Dubnium, is radioactive but belongs to a different group due to its distinct **electron configuration**.
 
 
 
• **Group 11**__
 
 
• Group 11 includes **copper (Cu)**, **silver (Ag)**, and **gold (Au)**.
 
• These elements are known as **coinage metals** due to their historical use in currency.
 
• They are highly **conductive** and possess unique **electrical and thermal properties**.
